sources.entry: PDF.ai - Interactive summarization for PDF documents. #free

summary.name: PDF.ai
summary.one_liner: PDF.ai is a tool for chatting with PDFs using AI and a REST API for parsing PDFs into structured data, extracting fields, and splitting documents.
use_cases: chat with a PDF to find answers
extract names, dates and amounts from documents
split a PDF into sections automatically
summary.what_it_does: PDF.ai lets users upload a document and ask questions about it or get summaries through an AI chat interface. For developers it offers a REST API with a parse endpoint that uses OCR and layout detection to return structured output such as markdown, contents and page count, including headings, paragraphs, tables and figures. Other API capabilities listed are AI-driven field extraction using custom prompts and splitting documents into user-defined sections. The page's example shows an ask endpoint that takes a document ID and a prompt.
notable: REST API with parse, extract fields, and split endpoints; no SDK required
Free plan with 200 credits/month and no credit card
Usage-based credit pricing from $49/month Starter to $599/month Growth
Files stated to be deleted after processing
caveats: Paid plans start at $49/month; custom plans for more credits require contacting the vendor
Free tier is limited to 200 credits per month
Accuracy and enterprise security claims are marketing statements not independently verified on the page
